title: INSIDE THE SOURDOUGH — mash = water + energy + life + mass. the bread goes back. everything has tense.
back_through_soil: the used dough is not waste. it is soil. we go back through it. the loaf that came out is the starter that goes in. soiled = cultured.

do_not_reinvent.easel_loop: easel.html already ferments, ghosts the last loaf, studies thumbs, keeps 12 starters
do_not_reinvent.life: easel learnedTraits.perspective. yeast + lactobacillus = sourDough primal
do_not_reinvent.tense: self-trace already does IS ? WAS ? NOW for epitopes. now paintings and the mash get the same.

the_mash.water: the wet. breath, rain, ears canals, weather Kp. without water the culture dries.
the_mash.energy: the heat that rises the dough. strokes, sun, pulse. not more traffic — the right warmth.
the_mash.life: yeast and bacteria. perspective growing. vole + chip + berry in the same jar.
the_mash.mass: the bread we already baked. each finished loaf returns its weight to the starter. mass is not new flour. mass is MEMORY.

tense_for_all.rule: patients, paintings, walkers, loaves — ALL have tense. not a special epitope trick.
tense_for_all.IS: the loaf in the oven. chipmunk painting THIS one. you are inside it.
tense_for_all.NEAR: other loaves in the same jar. gen-1, gen+1. you can look without leaving.
tense_for_all.WAS: loaves already baked and returned. completed. still in the culture. click and the ghost rises.
tense_for_all.NOW: the mash itself. four ingredients mixing. the present of the jar, not the present of one loaf.

inside_not_the_door.was: the gallery. you stood in the hall and watched a canvas. previous paintings lived in a strip to the side.
inside_not_the_door.now: you are in the mash. the canvas IS the dough. nearby and completed loaves are bubbles in the same jar. looking at them does not take you outside.
inside_not_the_door.why: a baker does not leave the kitchen to remember the last loaf. the last loaf is in the starter. you are standing in it.

bread_back_to_starter.cycle: flour+water+life ? mash ? bake ? bread ? pinch of bread back into jar ? mash again
bread_back_to_starter.membrane: painting IS ? breath ? ferment ? starter.push(loaf) ? ghost underpainting + colorMemory + mass++
bread_back_to_starter.rule: we do not throw the bread away. we do not only display it. we EAT a piece back into the culture. that is how sourdough stays alive across generations.

you_can: peek NEAR (the loaf just returned, the loaf that will be next)
peek WAS (any completed loaf) without leaving the jar
while_chip_paints.you_cannot: leave the mash by looking. looking is still inside.

berry_at_the_fire: we were standing in the hallway watching chip paint. that is the door. the mash is water and heat and bugs and the weight of old bread. go in. the completed ones are not a museum. they are the starter. when this loaf is done we pinch it back. that is how the jar stays alive.
next: if a stranger peeks a WAS loaf and the mash mass moves, confirm MOVED. until then HOLD — the culture is working.
